# Martinez Orlyn Glass & Mirror

> Houston-based glass and mirror company for custom shower enclosures, mirrors, windows, door glass, solar screens, reglazing and glass repair. Residential and commercial work is scheduled by appointment.

This is the official website for Martinez Orlyn Glass & Mirror. The company is family-owned, licensed and insured, and serves Houston, Texas and surrounding communities. Call (832) 253-2925 to discuss an appointment or confirm service-area coverage.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://glassmirrortx.us/): Company overview, core services, work process and common questions.
- [Services](https://glassmirrortx.us/services): Complete service directory.
- [Service areas](https://glassmirrortx.us/service-areas): Houston-area cities and local service information.
- [Gallery](https://glassmirrortx.us/gallery): Photographs of completed glass, mirror, shower and window work.
- [About](https://glassmirrortx.us/about): Company approach, mission and verified business details.
- [Contact](https://glassmirrortx.us/contact): Appointment request form, phone, email, WhatsApp and Messenger.

## Core services

- [Custom shower enclosures](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/custom-shower-enclosures): Custom-measured framed and frameless shower glass.
- [Shower doors](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/shower-doors): Shower door replacement and installation.
- [Custom mirrors](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/custom-mirrors): Mirrors sized for vanities, walls, gyms and commercial interiors.
- [Mirrored walls](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/mirrored-walls): Multi-panel mirror wall planning and installation.
- [Windows and doors](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/windows-and-doors): Window panes, door glass and replacement glass.
- [Double-pane windows](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/double-pane-windows): Failed insulated glass unit replacement.
- [Solar screens](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/solar-screens): Solar screen measurement and installation.
- [Glass installation and repair](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/glass-installation-repair): Residential and commercial glass repair and installation.
- [Reglazing](https://glassmirrortx.us/services/reglazing): Reglazing for compatible existing frames and openings.

## Service area

The company is based in Houston and publishes dedicated pages for Houston, Katy, Sugar Land, Cypress, Spring, Tomball, Humble, Conroe, Alvin and League City. Nearby projects are considered by practical drive time and job scope; call to confirm coverage.
